headline: Ravindra Energy Limited: Rights Issue Closure
sum: Ravindra Energy Limited closes its rights issue offering, completing the fundraising through equity subscription rights allotment to existing shareholders.
detail: Ravindra Energy Limited has intimated the closure of its rights issue to the stock exchange. The closure notice, filed with the National Stock Exchange on 24 June 2026, marks the completion of the company's rights-based capital raise. This follows the announcement of the offer to existing shareholders under SEBI's Institutional Common Disclosure Requirements framework. Post-closure, the company must file final results and allotment details with the exchange.
